title: Teferi Repairs the Shivan Rift
summary: Teferi sacrifices his old planeswalker powers to help restore a fractured Dominaria.
narrative: Centuries of planar disturbances had left dangerous temporal rifts across Dominaria. The effort to close them demanded unprecedented sacrifices.
Teferi helped repair the rift at Shiv, losing his planeswalker spark in the process and demonstrating the personal cost of healing reality.
